s.d: ἀπο-καθ-ίστημι (ἀποκαθιστάω, [[mark 9 12|Mrk.9:12]], Rec., -ιστάνω, LTTr.; cf. [[acts 1 6|Act.1:6;]] -κατιστάνω, WH), [in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;] 1. to restore, i.e. to a former condition: of health, [[matthew 12 13|Mat.12:13]], [[mark 3 5|Mrk.3:5 8:25]], [[luke 6 10|Luk.6:10]]; of social or political affairs, [[matthew 17 11|Mat.17:11]], [[mark 9 12|Mrk.9:12]], [[acts 1 6|Act.1:6]]. 2. to give back, bring back: [[hebrews 13 19|Heb.13:19]] (so in π., MM, see word; cf. also Cremer, 312).† (AS)

ἀπο-καλύπτω [in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ] 1. in general sense (cl.), to reveal, uncover, disclose, (a) of things: [[matthew 10 26|Mat.10:26]], [[luke 2 35|Luk.2:35 12:2]], [[1-corinthians 3 13|1Co.3:13]]; (b) of persons: pass., Christ, [[luke 17 30|Luk.17:30;]] Antichrist, [[2-thessalonians 2 3|2Th.2:3 2:6 2:8]] 2. In LXX and NT, in special sense of divine revelation: [[matthew 11 25|Mat.11:25]] (on the tense, see M, Pr., 136), ib. [[matthew 11 27|Mat.11:27 16:17]], [[luke 10 21|Luk.10:21-22]], [[john 12 38|Jhn.12:38]], [[romans 1 17|Rom.1:17-18 8:18]], [[1-corinthians 2 10|1Co.2:10 14:30]], [[galatians 1 16|Gal.1:16 3:23]], [[ephesians 3 5|Eph.3:5]], [[philippians 3 15|Php.3:15]], [[1-peter 1 5|1Pe.1:5-12 5:1]] (Westc., Eph., 178 f.; M, Th., 149 f.).† SYN.: φανερόω (see Thayer, 62; Cremer, 342).† (AS)

ἀπο-κάλυψις, -εως, ἡ (ἀποκαλύπτω), [in LXX: [[1-samuel 20 30|1Ki.20:30]] (עֶרְוָה), Sir.11:27 22:22 42:1 * ;] an uncovering, laying bare (Plut.). Metaphorical, a reveal­ing, revelation: a disclosure of divine truth, or a manifestion from God: [[luke 2 32|Luk.2:32]] [[romans 2 5|Rom.2:5 8:19 16:25]], [[1-corinthians 1 7|1Co.1:7 14:6 14:26]], [[2-corinthians 12 1|2Co.12:1 12:7]], [[galatians 1 12|Gal.1:12 2:2]], [[ephesians 1 17|Eph.1:17 3:3]] [[2-thessalonians 1 7|2Th.1:7]] [[1-peter 1 7|1Pe.1:7 1:13 4:13]], [[revelation 1 1|Rev.1:1]].† SYN.: ἐπιφάνεια, παρουσία, φανέρωσις (see Tr., Syn., xciv; Lft., Notes, 102, 178; Westc, Eph., 178 f.; M, Th., 145 ff.; Cremer, 343) (AS)

ἀπο-καραδοκία, -ας, ἡ (ἀποκαραδοκέω, used by Aq. in [[psalms 37 7|Psa.37:7]] for חוּל; ἀπό, κάρα the head, δοκέω, in Ion., to watch), to watch with outstretched head, watch anxiously (Polyb., π.; see Deiss., LAE, 374.5, 377 f.), [[romans 8 19|Rom.8:19]], [[philippians 1 20|Php.1:20]] (Lft., in l; Cremer, 177).† (AS)

ἀπο-κατ-αλλάσσω (cf. καταλλάσσω: ἀπό here signifies completely, see Lft., Col., l.with; Ellic., Eph., l.with; but also Mey., Eph., l.with), to reconcile completely: [[ephesians 2 16|Eph.2:16]], [[colossians 1 20|Col.1:20-21]].† (AS)
ἀπο-κατά-στασις, -εως, ἡ (ἀποκαθίστημι), restoration: [[acts 3 21|Act.3:21]] (in τ. of repairs and restorations of temples, see MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀπό-κειμαι [in LXX: [[genesis 49 10|Gen.49:10]] (שִׁילֹה), [[job 38 23|Job.38:23]] (חָשַׂךְ), 2Ma.12:45, 4Ma.8:11 * ;] to be laid up, in store, laid away: [[luke 19 20|Luk.19:20.]] Metaphorical, C. dative of person(s), to be reserved (Dem., Plat.; and see MM, see word): [[colossians 1 5|Col.1:5]], [[2-timothy 4 8|2Ti.4:8]], [[hebrews 9 27|Heb.9:27]].† (AS)
ἀπο-κεφαλίζω (ἀπό, κεφαλή), [in LXX: [[psalms 151 7|Psa.151:7]] * ;] to behead: [[matthew 14 10|Mat.14:10]], [[mark 6 16|Mrk.6:16, 28]] [[luke 9 9|Luk.9:9]].† (AS)
ἀπο-κλείω [in LXX chiefly for סָגַר ;] to shut fast: [[luke 13 25|Luk.13:25.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-κόπτω [in LXX for קָצַץ, כָּרַת, etc. ;] to cut off: [[mark 9 43|Mrk.9:43, 45]], [[john 18 10|Jhn.18:10, 26]] [[acts 27 32|Act.27:32]]. Mid., to mutilate oneself, have oneself mutilated: [[galatians 5 12|Gal.5:12]] (cf. [[deuteronomy 23 1|Deu.23:1]] LXX; and see Cremer, 751; MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀπό-κριμα, -τος, τό (ἀποκρίνω); 1. prop., a judicial sentence: [[2-corinthians 1 9|2Co.1:9]], R, mg. 2. an answer (see Thayer, see word): [[2-corinthians 1 9|2Co.1:9]], R, txt. (In FlJ, Ant., xiv, 10, 6, of a rescript of the Senate; in Inscr. of an official decision, Deiss., BS, 257; a reply to a deputation, MM, see word: cf. also Cremer, 3'75).† (AS)

ἀποκρίνω, ἀποκρίνομαι, [in LXX chiefly for ענה ;] in cl., 1. to separate, distinguish. 2. to choose. Mid., to answer: [[matthew 27 12|Mat.27:12]], [[mark 14 61|Mrk.14:61]], [[luke 3 16|Luk.3:16 23:9]], [[john 5 17|Jhn.5:17, 19]] [[acts 3 12|Act.3:12]]. In late Gk. the pass, also is used in this sense, and pass. forms are the more frequently in NT (M, Pr., 39, 161; MM, see word); (a) in general sense: absol., [[mark 12 34|Mrk.12:34;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 22 46|Mat.22:46;]] with dative of person(s), [[matthew 12 38|Mat.12:38;]] before πρός, [[acts 25 16|Act.25:16;]] (b) Hebraistically (i) like ענה, to begin to speak, take up the conversation (Kennedy, Sources, 124f.): [[matthew 11 25|Mat.11:25]], al., (ii) redundant, as in the Heb. phrase וַיַּעַן וַיּאֹמֶר (Dalman, Words, 24f., 38; M, Pr., 14; Bl., §58, 4; 74, 2; Cremer, 374): ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπε, [[matthew 4 4|Mat.4:4;]] ἔφη, 8:8; λέγει, [[mark 3 33|Mrk.3:33;]] in Jo most frequently (ἀπεκ. κ. εἶπε, 1:49. ) (AS)
ἀπό-κρισις, -εως, ἡ (ἀποκρίνομαι), [in LXX for דָּבָר, etc. ;] an answering, an answer: [[luke 2 47|Luk.2:47 20:26]], [[john 1 22|Jhn.1:22 19:9]].† (AS)

ἀπο-κρύπτω [in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;] to hide, conceal, keep secret: with accusative, [[luke 10 21|Luk.10:21;]] pass., [[1-corinthians 2 7|1Co.2:7]], [[ephesians 3 9|Eph.3:9]], [[colossians 1 26|Col.1:26]] (MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπόκρυφος, -ον (ἀποκρύπτω), [in LXX Chiefly for סֵתֶר ;] hidden: [[mark 4 22|Mrk.4:22]], [[luke 8 17|Luk.8:17]], [[colossians 2 3|Col.2:3]] (see Lft., in l; MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀπο-κτείνω (also in late forms -κτέννω, [[matthew 10 28|Mat.10:28]], a1., LTTr., -κτεννύω, [[mark 12 5|Mrk.12:5]], WH), [in LXX for הָרַג, מוּת ;] to kill: [[matthew 14 5|Mat.14:5]], al.; before instr. ἐν (which see), [[ephesians 2 16|Eph.2:16]], [[revelation 2 23|Rev.2:23]], al. Metaphorical: [[romans 7 11|Rom.7:11;]] τ. ἔχθραν, [[ephesians 2 16|Eph.2:16;]] τὸ γράμμα ἀποκτείνει [[2-corinthians 3 6|2Co.3:6]] (on the perfective force of this verb, see M, Pr., 114) (AS)

ἀπο-κυέω (Rec. -κύω), -ῶ (ἀπό, κυέω or κύω, to be pregnant), [in LXX: 4Ma.15:17 * ;] prop., "the medical word for birth as the close of pregnancy" (Hort, Ja., 26 f.). In κοιν, "an ordinary syn. of τίκτω, but definitely 'perfectivised' (M, Pr., 111 ff.; MM, see word) by the ἀπό, and so implying safe delivery," to bring forth, give birth to: [[james 1 15|Jas.1:15, 18]].† (AS)
ἀπο-κυλίω (see: κυλίω), [in LXX: [[genesis 29 3|Gen.29:3, 8 29:10]] (גָּלַל) Jdth.13:9 * ;] to roll away: [[matthew 28 2|Mat.28:2]], [[mark 16 3|Mrk.16:3]], [[luke 24 2|Luk.24:2]].† (AS)

ἀπο-λαμβάνω [in LXX: [[numbers 34 14|Num.34:14]] (לָקַח ([[deuteronomy 25 5|Deu.25:5]] A, [[isaiah 5 17|Isa.5:17]], 2Ma.4:46 2Mac 6:21 2Mac 8:6, 4Ma.18:23 * ;] 1. to receive from another; absol., to receive as one's due: [[luke 16 25|Luk.16:25 18:30]] (seel. λάβῃ) [[luke 23 41|Luk.23:41]], [[romans 1 27|Rom.1:27]], [[galatians 4 5|Gal.4:5]], [[colossians 3 24|Col.3:24]], 2Jn.8. 2. to receive back: [[luke 6 34|Luk.6:34 15:27]]. 3. to take apart or aside: [[mark 7 33|Mrk.7:33]] (cf. use in π. of the recluses of the Serapeum; MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπόλαυσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀπολαύω, to take of, enjoy a thing) [in LXX: 3Ma.7:16 * ;] enjoyment: [[1-timothy 6 17|1Ti.6:17]], [[hebrews 11 26|Heb.11:26]] (for late exx., see MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀπο-λείπω [in LXX for H2308 יָתַר, etc. ;] 1. to leave, leave behind (in π. a term. techn. in wills; see MM, see word): [[2-timothy 4 13|2Ti.4:13 4:20]], [[titus 1 5|Tit.1:5]]; pass., to be reserved, remain: [[hebrews 4 6|Heb.4:6, 9 10:26]]. 2. to desert, abandon: Ju 6.† (AS)
ἀπο-λείχω (for ἐπιλ-, which see), to lick up: [[luke 16 21|Luk.16:21]], Rec.† (AS)

ἀπ-όλλυμι and ἀπολλύω [in LXX for אָבַד, etc. (38 words in all)]. 1. Act., 1 to destroy utterly, destroy, kill: Mk 124, 922, al.; τ. ψνχήν, [[matthew 10 28|Mat.10:28]], al.; 2 to lose utterly: [[matthew 10 42|Mat.10:42]], al.; metaphorically, of failing to save, [[john 6 39|Jhn.6:39 18:9]]. 2. Mid., 1 to perish; (a) of things: [[matthew 5 29|Mat.5:29]], [[john 6 12|Jhn.6:12]], [[hebrews 1 11|Heb.1:11]] (LXX, al.; (b) of persons: [[matthew 8 26|Mat.8:26]], al. Metaphorical, of loss of eternal life, [[john 3 15|Jhn.3:15-16 10:28 17:12]], [[romans 2 12|Rom.2:12]], [[1-corinthians 8 11|1Co.8:11 15:18]], [[2-peter 3 9|2Pe.3:9]]. In οἱ ἀπολλὺμενοι, the perishing, contrasted in [[1-corinthians 1 18|1Co.1:18]], al., with οἱ σωζόμενοι, the "perfective" force of the verb, WH. " implies the completion of the process of destruction," is illustrated (see M, Pr., 114 f.; M, Th., ii, 2:10); 2 to be lost: [[luke 15 4|Luk.15:4 21:18]]. Metaphorical, on the basis of the relation between shepherd and flock, of spiritual destitution and alienation from God: [[matthew 10 6|Mat.10:6 15:24]], [[luke 19 10|Luk.19:10]] (MM, see word; DCG, i, 191 f., ii, 76, 554; Cremer, 451) (AS)
Ἀπολλύων, -οντος, ὁ (present ptcp. of ἀπολλύω), Apollyon, i.e. the Destroyer: [[revelation 9 11|Rev.9:11]] (cf. Ἀβάδδων). (Cremer, 453; DB, i, 125, 172.) † (AS)
Ἀπολλωνία, -ας, ἡ Apollonia, a city of Macedonia: [[acts 17 1|Act.17:1.]]† (AS)
Ἀπολλώς, -ώ, ὁ (perh. contr. from Ἀπολλώνιος, [[acts 18 24|Act.18:24]] D) Apollos: [[acts 18 24|Act.18:24 19:1]], [[1-corinthians 1 12|1Co.1:12 3:4-6 3:22 4:6 16:12]], [[titus 3 13|Tit.3:13]].† (AS)

ἀπολογέομαι, -οῦμαι (ἀπό, λόγος), [in LXX: [[jeremiah 12 1|Jer.12:1]] (רִיב) [[jeremiah 31 6|Jer.31:6]], 2Ma.13:26 * ;] 1. to defend: with accusative, [[romans 2 15|Rom.2:15.]] 2. to defend one's self: absol., [[luke 21 14|Luk.21:14]], [[acts 26 1|Act.26:1]]; before ὅτι, [[acts 25 8|Act.25:8;]] τί, to adduce something in one's defence, [[luke 12 11|Luk.12:11]], [[acts 26 24|Act.26:24]] (ταῦτα) [[acts 24 10|Act.24:10]] (τὰ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ); περί, with genitive of thing(s), and ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), [[acts 26 2|Act.26:2;]] with dative of person(s), [[acts 19 33|Act.19:33]], [[2-corinthians 12 19|2Co.12:19]].† (AS)

ἀπολογία, -ας, ἡ (ἀπολογέομαι), [in LXX: Wis.6:10 * ;] a speech in defence: [[acts 25 16|Act.25:16]], [[2-corinthians 7 11|2Co.7:11]], [[philippians 1 7|Php.1:7, 16]], [[2-timothy 4 16|2Ti.4:16]]; with dative of person(s), [[1-corinthians 9 3|1Co.9:3]], [[1-peter 3 15|1Pe.3:15]]; before πρός, [[acts 22 1|Act.22:1.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-λούω [in LXX: [[job 9 30|Job.9:30]] (רָחַץ)* ;] to wash off, wash away; mid., metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), to wash off oneself: ἀμαρτίας, [[acts 22 16|Act.22:16;]] absol., ἀπελούσασθε, ye washed yourselves clean (cf. Cremer, 406), [[1-corinthians 6 11|1Co.6:11.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-λύτρωσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀπολυτρόω, to release on payment of ransom, cf. λύτρον), [in LXX: Da (LXX) [[daniel 4 30|Dan.4:30]] with * ;] release effected by pay­ment of ransom, redemption, deliverance; metaphorically, [[hebrews 11 35|Heb.11:35;]] of deliverance thr. Christ from evil and the consequences of sin: [[luke 21 28|Luk.21:28]], [[romans 3 24|Rom.3:24]] (Vau., in l) 8:23, [[1-corinthians 1 30|1Co.1:30]], [[ephesians 1 7|Eph.1:7, 14 4:30]], [[colossians 1 14|Col.1:14]], [[hebrews 9 15|Heb.9:15]]. (On the extent to WH. the word retains the sense of ransom, see ICC, [[romans 3 24|Rom.3:24]], Westc., He., 297 ff.; see also ICC, Eph., 11; DCG, ii, 605; Cremer, 410; Deiss., LAE, 331; Lft., Notes, 271, 316; Tr., Syn., § 77.)† (AS)

ἀπο-λύω [in LXX for שׁוּב, etc., frequently in 1-4 Mac ;] 1. to set free, release: [[luke 13 12|Luk.13:12]], [[john 19 10|Jhn.19:10]], al.; a debtor, [[matthew 18 27|Mat.18:27;]] metaphorically, of forgive­ness, [[luke 6 37|Luk.6:37.]] 2. to let go, dismiss (Field, Notes, 9 f.): [[matthew 15 23|Mat.15:23]], [[luke 2 29|Luk.2:29 9:12]], [[acts 19 41|Act.19:41]], al.; of divorce, τ. γυναῖκα: [[matthew 1 19|Mat.1:19 5:31-32 19:3, 8 19:10]] [[mark 10 2|Mrk.10:2, 4 10:11]], [[luke 16 18|Luk.16:18]]; with ref. to Gk. and Rom. (net Jewish) custom, τ. ἄνδρα: [[mark 10 12|Mrk.10:12.]] Mid., to depart: [[acts 28 25|Act.28:25]] (MM, see word) (AS)

ἀπο-λύω [in LXX for שׁוּב, etc., frequently in 1-4 Mac ;] 1. to set free, release: [[luke 13 12|Luk.13:12]], [[john 19 10|Jhn.19:10]], al.; a debtor, [[matthew 18 27|Mat.18:27;]] metaphorically, of forgive­ness, [[luke 6 37|Luk.6:37.]] 2. to let go, dismiss (Field, Notes, 9 f.): [[matthew 15 23|Mat.15:23]], [[luke 2 29|Luk.2:29 9:12]], [[acts 19 41|Act.19:41]], al.; of divorce, τ. γυναῖκα: [[matthew 1 19|Mat.1:19 5:31-32 19:3, 8 19:10]] [[mark 10 2|Mrk.10:2, 4 10:11]], [[luke 16 18|Luk.16:18]]; with ref. to Gk. and Rom. (net Jewish) custom, τ. ἄνδρα: [[mark 10 12|Mrk.10:12.]] Mid., to depart: [[acts 28 25|Act.28:25]] (MM, see word) (AS)
απο-μάσσω (μάσσω, Att... -ττω, to touch, handle), [in LXX: Tob.7:17 * ;] to wipe off, wire clean: mid., [[luke 10 11|Luk.10:11.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-νέμω (νέμω, to distribute), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 4 19|Deu.4:19]] (חָלַק), 3Ma.1:7 3Mac 3:16 * ;] to assign, apportion: [[1-peter 3 7|1Pe.3:7.]] (In π. of a Prefect who renders to all their dues; see MM, see word)† (AS)
ἀπο-νίπτω [in LXX for שָׁטַף, רָחַץ, מָחָה ;] to wash off: mid. (reflex.), τ. χεῖρας, [[matthew 27 24|Mat.27:24.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-πίπτω [in LXX for מָלַל, נָפַל, etc. ;] to fall off: [[acts 9 18|Act.9:18.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-πλανάω, -ῶ [in LXX for נָדַח hi., נָטָה hi., שׁוּב pi. ;] to cause to go astray; metaphorically, of leading into error: [[mark 13 22|Mrk.13:22;]] pass., to be led astray: [[1-timothy 6 10|1Ti.6:10.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-πλέω, -ῶ to sail away: [[acts 13 4|Act.13:4 14:26 20:15 27:1]] (Burton, 159).† (AS)
ἀπο-πλύνω [in LXX chiefly for כָּבַס pi. ;] to wash off: seel. for πλύνω, [[luke 5 2|Luk.5:2]], Rec.† (AS)
ἀπο-πνίγω [in LXX: [[nahum 2 13|Nam.2:13]] (חָנַק pi.), Tob.3:8 * ;] to choke: [[matthew 13 7|Mat.13:7]], [[luke 8 7|Luk.8:7]]; pass., of drowning (= καταποντίζομαι), [[luke 8 33|Luk.8:33.]]† (AS)

ἀπορέω, -ῶ (ἄπορος, ἀ- neg., πόρος, a way, resource), [in LXX for צָרַר, מוּךְ, etc. ;] to be at a loss, be perplexed: absol., [[mark 6 20|Mrk.6:20]] (ἐποίει, R, mg.); mid., be in doubt: absol., [[2-corinthians 4 8|2Co.4:8;]] with accusative, [[acts 25 20|Act.25:20;]] before περί, [[luke 24 4|Luk.24:4;]] ἐν, [[galatians 4 20|Gal.4:20;]] περὶ τίνος λέγει, [[john 13 22|Jhn.13:22.]]† SYN.: διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, διστάζω, μετεωρίζομαι (see DCG, i, 491) (AS)
ἀπορία, -ας, ἡ (ἀπορέω), [in LXX for בֶּהָלָה, etc. ;] perplexity: [[luke 21 25|Luk.21:25]] (MM, see word; on the construction, see Field, Notes, 74 f.).† (AS)
ἀπο-ρίπτω (Rec. -ρρίπτω, c1.), [in LXX for שָׁלַךְ hi., etc. ;] to throw away, cast forth: reflexively, [[acts 27 43|Act.27:43]] (BV, cast themselves overboard; see MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπ-ορφανίζω (ἀπό, ὀρφανός), to be bereaved (prop., of a parent, Lft., Notes, 36); metaphorically, [[1-thessalonians 2 17|1Th.2:17]] (where Field thinks it = χωρισθέντες, Notes, 199).† (AS)

ἀπο-σκευάζω [in LXX: [[leviticus 14 36|Lev.14:36]] (פָּנָה pi.) * ;] to pack and carry off; mid., to pack and remove one's goods: [[acts 21 15|Act.21:15]], Rec. (see ἐπισ-).† ἐπι-σκευάζω, [in LXX for pm pi., etc. ;] to equip, make ready; mid., to make one's preparations: [[acts 21 15|Act.21:15.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-σκίασμα, -τος, τό (ἀποσκιάζω, to cast a shadow; v,s. σκία) a shadow: [[james 1 17|Jas.1:17]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀπο-σπάω, -ῶ [in LXX for נָתַק: ni., hi., etc. ;] to draw off or away, tear away (MM, see word): [[acts 20 30|Act.20:30;]] μάχαιραν, draw a sword, [[matthew 26 51|Mat.26:51;]] pass., to be parted or withdrawn (Field, Notes, 134; but see Thayer, see word), [[luke 22 41|Luk.22:41]], [[acts 21 1|Act.21:1]].† (AS)

άποστασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀφίστημι), [in LXX for מַעַל, etc. ;] defection, apostasy, revolt; in late Gk. (MM, Exp., viii; Lft., Notes, 111; Cremer, 308) for cl. ἀπόστασις, frequently in sense of political revolt, in LXX (e.g. [[joshua 22 22|Jos.22:22]], [[2-chronicles 29 19|2Ch.29:19]], [[jeremiah 2 19|Jer.2:19]]) and NT always of religious apostasy: [[acts 21 21|Act.21:21]], [[2-thessalonians 2 3|2Th.2:3]].† (AS)

ἀποστάσιον, -ου, τό (ἀφίστημι), [in LXX; [[deuteronomy 24 1|Deu.24:1]], 3, [[jeremiah 3 8|Jer.3:8]], [[isaiah 50 1|Isa.50:1]] (כְּרִיתוּת) * ;] 1. in cl., only in phrase ἀποστασίου δίκη, an action against a freedman for forsaking his προστάτης (Dem.). 2. In LXX, βιβλίον ἀποστασίου, a bill of divorce: [[matthew 19 7|Mat.19:7]], [[mark 10 4|Mrk.10:4]]; in same sense ἀ. alone (MM, see word), [[matthew 5 31|Mat.5:31]] (for other late exx., see MM, l.with; Kennedy, Sources, 121).† (AS)
ἀπο-στεγάζω (στέγη), [in Sm.: [[jeremiah 29 11|Jer.29:11]] * ;] to unroof: [[mark 2 4|Mrk.2:4.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-στέλλω, [in LXX very freq., almost always for שׁלח ;] prop., to send away, to dispatch on service; 1. to send with a commission, or on service; (a) of persons: Christ, [[matthew 10 40|Mat.10:40;]] the apostles, 10:16; servants, [[mark 12 2|Mrk.12:2;]] angels, 13:27; (b) of things: ὄνος, [[matthew 21 3|Mat.21:3;]] τὸ δρέπανον, [[mark 4 29|Mrk.4:29;]] τ. λόγον, [[acts 10 36|Act.10:36;]] τ. ἐπαγγελίαν (i.e. the promised Holy Spirit), [[luke 24 49|Luk.24:49]], Rec.; before εἰς, [[matthew 20 2|Mat.20:2]], [[luke 11 49|Luk.11:49]], [[john 3 17|Jhn.3:17]]; ὀπίσω, [[luke 19 14|Luk.19:14;]] ἔμπροσθεν, [[john 3 28|Jhn.3:28;]] πρὸ προσώπου, [[matthew 11 10|Mat.11:10;]] πρός, [[matthew 21 34|Mat.21:34;]] with ref. to sender or place of departure: ἀπό, [[luke 1 26|Luk.1:26]] (Rec. ὑπό); παρά, [[john 1 6|Jhn.1:6;]] ἐκ, [[john 1 19|ib. 1:19]]; ὑπό, [[acts 10 17|Act.10:17]] (Rec. ἀπό); before inf., [[mark 3 14|Mrk.3:14]], al.; ἵνα, [[mark 12 2|Mrk.12:2]], al.; εἰς (of purpose), [[hebrews 1 14|Heb.1:14;]] without direct obj.: before πρός, [[john 5 33|Jhn.5:33;]] λέγων, [[john 11 3|Jhn.11:3;]] ἀποστείλας, with indic., [[matthew 2 16|Mat.2:16]], [[acts 7 14|Act.7:14]], [[revelation 1 1|Rev.1:1]]. 2. to send away, dismiss: [[luke 4 18|Luk.4:18]], [[mark 5 10|Mrk.5:10 8:26 12:3]] (cf. ἐξ-, συν-αποστέλλω). SYN.: πέμπω, the general term. ἀ. "suggests official or authoritative sending" (see Thayer, see word πέμπω; Westc., Jo., 298; Epp. Jo., 125; Cremer, 529; MM, see word). (AS)

ἀπο-στερέω, -ῶ (στερέω, to rob), [in LXX: [[exodus 21 10|Exo.21:10]] (גָּרַע), [[deuteronomy 24 14|Deu.24:14]] (עָשַׁק), [[malachi 3 5|Mal.3:5]], Sir.4:1 29:6-7 31:21-22 * ;] to defraud, deprive of, despoil (in cl. chiefly of the misappropriation of trust funds, Field, Notes, 33; cf. MM, see word): absol., [[mark 10 19|Mrk.10:19]], [[1-corinthians 6 8|1Co.6:8]]; with accusative of person(s), [[1-corinthians 7 5|1Co.7:5.]] Mid., endure deprivation: [[1-corinthians 6 7|1Co.6:7]] (WM, § 38, 3; but see Bl., § 54, 5; M, Pr., 162); pass., ἀπεστερημένοι, bereft of: [[1-timothy 6 5|1Ti.6:5.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀποστέλλω), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 22 7|Deu.22:7]], [[1-kings 4 34|3Ki.4:34 9:16]] [[psalms 78 49|Psa.78:49]], [[ecclesiastes 8 8|Ecc.8:8]], [[song-of-solomon 4 13|Sng.4:13]] (for שָׁלַח and its cognates), 1Es.9:51 [[esther 9 54|Est.9:54]], [[jeremiah 32 36|Jer.32:36]], Bar.2:25, 1Ma.2:18, 2Ma.3:2 *.] 1. In cl., a sending away (MM, see word), as, an expedition (Hdt.). 2. In LXX (a) discharge, dis­missal ([[ecclesiastes 8 8|Ecc.8:8]]); (b) a gift (3Ki.9:16, 1Ma.2:13). 3. In NT, the office of an Apostle of Christ, apostleship: [[acts 1 25|Act.1:25]], [[romans 1 5|Rom.1:5]], [[1-corinthians 9 2|1Co.9:2]], [[galatians 2 8|Gal.2:8]] (Cremer, 530).† (AS)

ἀπόστολος, -ου, ὁ (ἀοστέλλω), [in LXX; [[1-kings 14 6|3Ki.14:6]] A (שָׁלַח) * ;] 1. a fleet, an expedition (Dem.). 2. a messenger, one sent on a mission (Hdt., LXX, l.with, and π.; see M, Pr., 37 f.; MM, see word; M, Th., i, 2:7 and reff.): [[john 13 16|Jhn.13:16]], [[2-corinthians 8 23|2Co.8:23]] [[philippians 2 25|Php.2:25]]. 3. In NT, an Apostle of Christ (a) with special ref. to the Twelve: [[matthew 10 2|Mat.10:2]], [[mark 3 14|Mrk.3:14]], [[luke 11 49|Luk.11:49]], [[ephesians 3 5|Eph.3:5]], [[revelation 18 20|Rev.18:20]], al., equality with whom is claimed by St. Paul, [[galatians 1 1|Gal.1:1, 11]] ff, [[1-timothy 2 7|1Ti.2:7]], a1.; (b) in a wider sense of prominent Christian teachers, as Barnabas, [[acts 14 14|Act.14:14]], apparently also Silvanus and Timothy, [[1-thessalonians 2 6|1Th.2:6]], and perhaps Andronicus and Junias (Junia?), [[romans 16 7|Rom.16:7]] (see ICC, in l); of false teachers, claiming apostleship: [[2-corinthians 11 5|2Co.11:5 11:13]], [[revelation 2 2|Rev.2:2]]. (On the different uses of the term in NT, see Lit., Gal., 92-101; Cremer, 530; DB, i, 126; DCG, i, 105; Enc. Br., ii, 196 ff.) (AS)
ἀποστοματίζω (στόμα), 1. In cl., to speak from memory, to dic­tate to a pupil (Plat.). 2. In late Gk., to catechize, question: [[luke 11 53|Luk.11:53]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀπο-στρέφω [in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;] trans., with accusative, (a) to turn away, remove: [[romans 11 26|Rom.11:26]], [[2-timothy 4 4|2Ti.4:4]]; metaphorically, to turn away from allegiance, pervert: [[luke 23 14|Luk.23:14;]] (b) to turn back, return: μάχαιραν, [[matthew 26 52|Mat.26:52.]] Pass., reflex., to turn oneself away from: with accusative, [[matthew 5 42|Mat.5:42]], [[2-timothy 1 15|2Ti.1:15]], [[titus 1 14|Tit.1:14]], [[hebrews 12 25|Heb.12:25]]; so act., absol., [[acts 3 26|Act.3:26]] (cf. Sir.8:5; Bl., § 53, 1; Cremer, 880).† (AS)
ἀπο-στυγέω, -ῶ (στυγέω, to hate), to abhor: [[romans 12 9|Rom.12:9.]]† (AS)
ἀποσυνάγωγος, -ον (συναγωγή), expelled from the congregation (Field, Notes, 96), excommunicated: [[john 9 22|Jhn.9:22 12:42 16:2]] (Cremer, 64, 607).† (AS)

ἀπο-τάσσω [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 2 20|Ecc.2:20]] (יָאַשׁ pi.), I [[esther 6 27|Est.6:27]], [[jeremiah 20 2|Jer.20:2, 1-18]]; 1Ma.4:1-61 * ;] to set apart. Mid., in late Gk. (El., § 37, 1; Swete, Mk., 136 f.; MM, e. dative, (a) to take leave of: [[mark 6 46|Mrk.6:46]], [[luke 9 61|Luk.9:61]], [[acts 18 18|Act.18:18, 21]], [[2-corinthians 2 13|2Co.2:13]]; (b) to forsake: [[luke 14 33|Luk.14:33.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-τελέω, -ῶ [in LXX: I [[esther 5 73|Est.5:73]], 1Ma.15:39 * ;] to bring to an end, complete, accomplish (cf. MM, see word): [[luke 13 32|Luk.13:32]], [[james 1 15|Jas.1:15]].† (AS)

ἀπο-τίθημι [in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ hi. ;] to put off or aside; in NT always mid., (a) to put of from oneself as a garment: τ. ἱμάτια, [[acts 7 58|Act.7:58;]] metaphorically, in ethical sense, to put of, lay aside: [[romans 13 12|Rom.13:12]], [[ephesians 4 22|Eph.4:22, 25]], [[colossians 3 8|Col.3:8]], [[hebrews 12 1|Heb.12:1]], [[james 1 21|Jas.1:21]], [[1-peter 2 1|1Pe.2:1]]; (b) to stow away, put: ἐν τ. φυλακῇ (MM, see word), [[matthew 14 3|Mat.14:3.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-τινάσσω [in LXX: [[judges 16 20|Jdg.16:20]] A (נָעַר ni.), [[1-samuel 10 2|1Ki.10:2]] (נָטַשׁ), [[lamentations 2 7|La 2:7]] (נָאַר pi.) * ;] to shake of: [[luke 9 5|Luk.9:5]], [[acts 28 5|Act.28:5]].† (AS)
ἀπο-τίνω (or -τίω) [in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם pi. ;] to pay off, repay: Phm 19 (MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπο-τολμάω, -ῶ to be quite bold, make a bold venture: [[romans 10 20|Rom.10:20.]]† (AS)

ἀποτομία, -ας, ἡ (ἀποτέμνω, to cut of), [in Sm.: [[jeremiah 51 35|Jer.51:35]], [[nahum 3 1|Nam.3:1]] * ;] steepness, sharpness; metaphorically, severity (MM, see word): [[romans 11 22|Rom.11:22.]]† (AS)
ἀποτόμως adv., [in LXX: Wis.5:22 * ;] abruptly, curtly, hence sharply, severely: [[2-corinthians 13 10|2Co.13:10]], [[titus 1 13|Tit.1:13]] (MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπο-τρέπω [in LXX: Sir.20:29 48:18, 3Ma.1:23, 4Ma.1:33 4Mac 16:12 * ;] to turn away; mid., to turn oneself away from: with accusative, [[2-timothy 3 5|2Ti.3:5.]]† (AS)
ἀπουσία, -ας, ἡ (ἄπειμι); 1. absence (Æsch., Thuc.): [[philippians 2 12|Php.2:12]], 2. deficiency, waste (MM, s.v).† (AS)

ἀπο-φέρω [in LXX for הָלַךְ, etc. ;] to carry off, bear, or lead away: with accusative, [[mark 15 1|Mrk.15:1]], [[1-corinthians 16 3|1Co.16:3]], [[revelation 17 3|Rev.17:3 21:10]]. Pass., [[luke 16 22|Luk.16:22]], [[acts 19 12|Act.19:12]].† (AS)
ἀπο-φεύγω [in LXX: Sir.22:22 * ;] to flee from, escape: with accusative, [[2-peter 2 18|2Pe.2:18 2:20]]; with genitive, [[2-peter 1 4|2Pe.1:4.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-φθέγγομαι [in LXX for נָבָא, etc. ;] to speak forth, give utterance: [[acts 2 4|Act.2:4, 14 26:25]] (MM, s. see).† (AS)
ἀπο-φορτίζομαι (φορτίζω, to load), to discharge a cargo (Field, Notes, 134), to unlade: with accusative, τ. γόμον, [[acts 21 3|Act.21:3.]]† (AS)
ἀπό-χρησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀποχράομαι, to use to the full, abuse) abuse, misuse: [[colossians 2 22|Col.2:22]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀπο-χωρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[jeremiah 46 5|Jer.46:5]] (סוּג), 2Ma.4:33, 3Ma.2:33 * ;] to go away, depart, withdraw: before ἀπό, [[matthew 7 23|Mat.7:23]], [[luke 9 39|Luk.9:39]], [[acts 13 13|Act.13:13]] (absol., [[luke 20 20|Luk.20:20]], Tr., mg.).† (AS)
ἀπο-χωρίζω [in LXX: [[ezekiel 43 21|Eze.43:21]] (מִפְקָד)* ;] to separate, part asunder: pass., [[revelation 6 14|Rev.6:14;]] reflexively, to separate oneself: [[acts 15 39|Act.15:39.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-ψύχω [in LXX: 4Ma.15:18 * ;] 1. to breathe out life, expire (Thue.; LXX, l.with). 2. to leave off breathing, faint (Hom., Od., xxiv, 348): before ἀπό, [[luke 21 26|Luk.21:26.]]† (AS)
Ἀππιος, -ου, ὁ Appius; Ἀππίου Φόρον, Appii Forum (Market of Appius), a town in Italy: [[acts 28 15|Act.28:15.]]† (AS)
ἀ-πρόσ-ιτος, -ον (πρόσειμι, to go to), unapproachable: φῶς, [[1-timothy 6 16|1Ti.6:16.]]† (AS)

ἀπρόσκοπος, -ον (προσκόπτω), [in LXX: Sir.32:21, 3Ma.3:8 * ;] 1. act., not causing to stumble: metaphorically, of not leading others into sin, [[1-corinthians 10 32|1Co.10:32.]] 2. Pass., not stumbling, without offence, blameless: [[acts 24 16|Act.24:16]], [[philippians 1 10|Php.1:10]] (for exx., see MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπροσωπολήμπτως (Rec. -λήπτως, cl.), adv. (α- neg., προσωπολήμπτης), without respect of persons, impartially: [[1-peter 1 17|1Pe.1:17.]]† (AS)
ἄ-πταιστος, -ον (πταίω), [in LXX: 3Ma.6:39 * ;] without stumbling, sure-footed: metaphorically (MM, see word), Ju 24.† (AS)

to touch, hold, handle; (act.) to start a fire; "to touch a woman" means "to get married" primarily to bring in contact, fit, fasten; to light, kindle, [[mark 4 21|Mk. 4:21]]; [[luke 8 16|Lk. 8:16]]; to touch, [[matthew 8 3|Mt. 8:3]]; to meddle, venture to partake, [[colossians 2 21|Col. 2:21;]] to have intercourse with, to know carnally, [[1-corinthians 7 1|1Cor. 7:1;]] by implication to harm, [[1-john 5 18|1Jn. 5:18]]

ἅπτω [in LXX chiefly for נָגַע ;] prop., to fasten to; hence, of fire, to kindle, light: [[luke 8 16|Luk.8:16 11:33 15:8]], [[acts 28 2|Act.28:2]]. Mid., with genitive, to fasten oneself to, cling to, lay hold of (so in π.; MM, see word): [[matthew 8 3|Mat.8:3, 15]], [[john 20 17|Jhn.20:17]], al.; of carnal intercourse, [[1-corinthians 7 1|1Co.7:1;]] with reference to levitical and ceremonial prohibitions, [[2-corinthians 6 17|2Co.6:17]], [[colossians 2 21|Col.2:21]]; of hostile action, [[1-john 5 18|1Jn.5:18]] (cf. ἀν-, καθ-, περι- άπτω) SYN.: θιγγάνω, ψηλαφάω. ἅ. is the stronger, θ., to touch, the lighter term. ψ. is to feel, as in search of something (Tr., Syn., § xvii; Lft., Col., 201 f.) (AS)
Ἀπφία, -ας, ἡ Apphia: Phm 2 (MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀπ-ωθέω, -ῶ [in LXX for זָנַח, מָאַס, etc. ;] to thrust away. Mid., to thrust away from oneself, refuse, reject: with accusative of person(s) (MM, see word), [[acts 7 27|Act.7:27, 39 13:46]], [[romans 11 1|Rom.11:1-2]], [[1-timothy 1 19|1Ti.1:19]].† (AS)

ἀπώλεια, -ας, ἡ (ἀπόλλυμι), [in LXX (Cremer, 797) for אָבַד, אֵיד, etc. ;] destruction, waste, loss, perishing (in π., of money, see MM, see word): [[matthew 26 8|Mat.26:8]], [[mark 14 4|Mrk.14:4]], [[acts 8 20|Act.8:20]], [[romans 9 22|Rom.9:22]], [[1-timothy 6 9|1Ti.6:9]], [[2-peter 2 1|2Pe.2:1]]; in special sense of the loss of eternal life, perdition, the antithesis of σωτηρία: [[matthew 7 13|Mat.7:13]], [[john 17 12|Jhn.17:12]], [[philippians 1 28|Php.1:28 3:19]], [[2-thessalonians 2 3|2Th.2:3]], [[hebrews 10 39|Heb.10:39]], [[2-peter 2 3|2Pe.2:3 3:7 3:16]], [[revelation 17 8|Rev.17:8, 11]] (DB, iii, 744).† (AS)
ἀρά, -ᾶς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for אָלָה ]; 1. a prayer (MM, see word). 2. (as in Homer) a curse, malediction: [[romans 3 14|Rom.3:14]] (LXX),† (AS)

ἄρα, illative particle, expressing a more subjective or informal inference than οὖν, then: prop. (as in cl.), the second word in the sentence, [[romans 7 21|Rom.7:21 8:1]], [[galatians 3 7|Gal.3:7]]; ἐπεὶ ἄρα, [[1-corinthians 7 14|1Co.7:14]] (with another word between) 5:10; as the first word, [[luke 11 48|Luk.11:48]], [[acts 11 18|Act.11:18]], [[romans 10 17|Rom.10:17]], [[1-corinthians 15 18|1Co.15:18]], [[2-corinthians 5 15|2Co.5:15 7:12]], [[hebrews 4 9|Heb.4:9]]; so prop. in apodosis after protasis with εἰ, [[matthew 12 28|Mat.12:28]], [[luke 11 20|Luk.11:20]], [[galatians 2 21|Gal.2:21 3:29 5:11]], [[hebrews 12 8|Heb.12:8]] (κενὸν ἄρα), [[1-corinthians 15 14|1Co.15:14;]] often in interrogations, direct and indirect, τίς (τί) ἄρα, [[matthew 18 1|Mat.18:1 19:25, 27 24:45]], [[mark 4 41|Mrk.4:41]], [[luke 1 66|Luk.1:66 8:25 12:42 22:23]], [[acts 12 18|Act.12:18]]; εἰ ἄρα, [[mark 11 13|Mrk.11:13]], [[acts 8 22|Act.8:22]]; εἴπερ ἄρα, [[1-corinthians 15 15|1Co.15:15;]] οὐκ ἄρα, [[acts 21 38|Act.21:38;]] μήτι ἄρα, [[2-corinthians 1 17|2Co.1:17;]] in strengthened forms, ἄρα γε, ἄραγε, [[matthew 7 20|Mat.7:20 17:26]], [[acts 17 27|Act.17:27]], and more frequently ἄρα οὖν (Epp. Paul.), so then, [[romans 5 18|Rom.5:18 7:3, 25 8:12 9:16, 18 14:19]], [[galatians 6 10|Gal.6:10]], [[ephesians 2 19|Eph.2:19]], [[1-thessalonians 5 6|1Th.5:6]], [[2-thessalonians 2 15|2Th.2:15]] (Bl., §77, 2; 78, 5; MM, see word).† (AS)

ἆρα, interrog. particle, implying anxiety or impatience, "quite rare and only in Luke and Paul, therefore a literary word" (Bl., §77, 2). 1. (num igitur) expecting a neg. reply, [[luke 18 8|Luk.18:8;]] ἆρά γε, [[acts 8 30|Act.8:30.]] 2. (ergone) in apodosis, expecting an affirm. reply, [[galatians 2 17|Gal.2:17]] (Bl., l.with; Lft., Ga., in l.; MM, see word). † (AS)
Arabia , (Herdotus Historicus), poetry Ἀρραβία, (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus) (ML)
Ἀράμ indec. (Heb. רָם), Aram: [[matthew 1 3|Mat.1:3-4]], [[luke 3 33|Luk.3:33]] (R, txt., WH, Ἀρνεί).† (AS)
Ἄραψ, -αβος, ὁ an Arabian: [[acts 2 11|Act.2:11.]]† (AS)

ἀργέω, -ῶ (ἀργός), [in LXX: [[esther 4 24|Est.4:24]], [[ecclesiastes 12 3|Ecc.12:3]] (בָּטֵל), I [[esther 2 30|Est.2:30]], Sir.33:27), 2Ma.5:25 * ;] to be idle; τὸ κρίμα . . . ἀ., lingers (cf. MGr. ἀργά, late: MM, see word): [[2-peter 2 3|2Pe.2:3.]]† (AS)

ἀργός, -όν (in late Gk., incl. NT, -ή, -όν; ἀ- neg., ἔργον) [in LXX: [[1-kings 6 7|3Ki.6:7]] (מַסָּע), Wis.14:5 15:15, Sir.37:11 38:28 * ;] inactive, idle: [[matthew 20 3|Mat.20:3]], 6, [[1-timothy 5 13|1Ti.5:13]], [[titus 1 12|Tit.1:12]], [[2-peter 1 8|2Pe.1:8]]. Metaphorical, of things, inactive, ineffective, worthless: ῥῆμα, [[matthew 12 36|Mat.12:36;]] πίστις, [[james 2 20|Jas.2:20]] (see Cremer, 259 f.).† SYN.: βραδύς, slow; νωθρός, sluggish (Tr., Syn., § civ) (AS)
ἀργύρεος (see MM, see word), -οῦς, -ᾶ, -οῦν (ἄργυρος), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ;] of silver: [[acts 19 24|Act.19:24]] (WH, br.), [[2-timothy 2 20|2Ti.2:20]], [[revelation 9 20|Rev.9:20]].† (AS)

ἀργύριον, -ου, τό (ἄργυρος), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ([[genesis 13 2|Gen.13:2]], al.), exc. [[lamentations 4 1|La 4:1]] (כֶּתֶם) ;] prop., a piece of silver (Lft., Notes, 191); in NT, (a) silver: [[acts 3 6|Act.3:6 7:16 19:19 20:33]], [[1-corinthians 3 12|1Co.3:12]], [[1-peter 1 18|1Pe.1:18]]; (b) money: [[matthew 25 18|Mat.25:18, 27]], [[mark 14 11|Mrk.14:11]], [[luke 9 3|Luk.9:3 19:15, 23 22:5]], [[acts 8 20|Act.8:20]]; (with) a silver coin: p1., [[matthew 26 15|Mat.26:15 27:3-6, 9 28:12, 15]], where the value is that of a shekel or tetradrachm; ἀργυρίου μυριάδες πέντε (prob. drachmas; MM, see word), [[acts 19 19|Act.19:19.]]† (AS)
ἀργυροκόπος, -ου, ὁ (ἄργυρος, κόπτω, to beat) [in LXX: [[judges 17 4|Jdg.17:4]], [[jeremiah 6 29|Jer.6:29]] (צָרַף) * ;] a silversmith: [[acts 19 24|Act.19:24]] (Plut.; 77., see MM, see word).† (AS)

ἄργυρος, -ου, ὁ (ἀργός, shining), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ;] silver (on its relation to ἀργύριον, see MM, see word): [[matthew 10 9|Mat.10:9]], [[acts 17 29|Act.17:29]], [[james 5 5|Jas.5:5]], [[revelation 18 12|Rev.18:12]].† (AS)
Ἄρειος Πάυος (T, Ἄριος Π.), -ου, ὁ Hill of Pres or Mars, Areopagus; also, the Court of Areopagus, the highest tribunal of Athens: [[acts 17 19|Act.17:19, 22]].† (AS)
Ἀρεοπαγίτης (T, -είτης), -ου, ὁ (see supr.), a judge of the Court of Areopagus: [[acts 17 34|Act.17:34.]]† (AS)

ἀρεσκία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ (ἀρέσκω), [in LXX (-εία): [[proverbs 31 30|Pro.31:30]] (חֵן) * ;] pleasing, desire to please: [[colossians 1 19|Col.1:19]] In Gk. writers (Arist., Polyb.), most frequently in bad sense, but in π., Inscr., and in Philo, as above (see Deiss., BS, 224; MM, see word; Cremer, 642).† (AS)
